item.title: Minor flood warning issued for several low-lying areas of Mahaweli River Basin
item.description: The Irrigation Department has issued a potential minor flood warning valid for the next 24 hours for several low-lying areas along the Mahaweli River Basin due to rainfall received since last night (21) in certain catchment areas. MORE..

item.title: 21-year-old killed in road accident in Colombo–Kandy road
item.description: A 21-year-old youth has died following a road accident in the Weweldeniya area along the Colombo–Kandy main road. MORE..

item.title: 25-year-old woman arrested with Ice in Mount Lavinia
item.description: A 25-year-old woman has been arrested for possession of 110 grams of Crystal methamphetamine (commonly known as “Ice”) during a raid carried out in the William Place area of Mount Lavinia. MORE..

item.title: More details revealed on gunman arrested over Akuregoda double murder
item.description: More details have been revealed by the police regarding the gunman arrested yesterday (21) in connection with the double homicide in Akuregoda, Thalangama. MORE..

item.title: Double cab overturns near Monaragala town; Damages main water pipeline
item.description: A double cab has reportedly veered off the road and toppled down from a bridge along the Monaragala–Pottuvil main road, near Monaragala town. MORE..

item.title: 29-year-old arrested with over 250g of heroin in Anuradhapura
item.description: An individual has been arrested in Anuradhapura for possession of 255 grams of the narcotic substance heroin. MORE..

item.title: 3 injured as train hits vehicle at Payagala; Coastal line trains delayed
item.description: A Coastal Line train has collided with a cab at a railway crossing in Payagala, injuring three individuals. MORE..

item.title: Landslide Red warnings issued for four districts extended
item.description: The National Building Research Organisation (NBRO) has extended Level 3 (Red) landslide warnings issued to several Divisional Secretariat Divisions (DSDs) across four districts due to prevailing heavy rainfall. MORE..

item.title: Eheliyagoda records highest rainfall; Thundershowers likely this afternoon
item.description: Eheliyagoda in Ratnapura received 171mm of rain, the highest rainfall within the past 24 hours, according to the Department of Meteorology. MORE..
